{{Quote|And the manufacturer, Sub-Capital Division&mdash;again aha. The subfield says HyperTech Industries. Look that up for me, would you?''"<br />"''An Alliance military contractor based out of Kuat.|Garik Loran and Davian|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Sub-Capital Division''' was a manufacturing division of [[HyperTech Industries]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. It manufactured secure privacy types, one-person enclosed [[Hypercomm/Legends|hypercomm]] systems designed to allow a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] or communications officer to communicate without being observed by the rest of the bridge crew.<ref name="MK" />

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Garik Loran]] and [[Davian]] discovered through cargo manifests that devices manufactured by Sub-Capital Division had been transported aboard every [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Navy]] cargo vessel that disappeared over a three-year period.<ref name="MK" />
